outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of flow cytometry dot plots where each point represents an individual cell; these are scatter-type plots, not bar charts of averaged data, so overlay of individual points is not required.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots of individual events/cells with gating, not summary/average statistics requiring individual point overlay.
Panel C shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots of individual cells (NP-binding GC/MBC gating), not averaged data in bar-chart form.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells (MBC, GC, naive populations), which inherently displays individual data points rather than an average summary.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots of individual cells for MBC subsets, not a bar/summary plot requiring individual point overlay.
